parts.t: The City of Langley is its own municipality, separate from the Township of Langley. It covers about 10 square kilometres, with the Nicomekl River flowing through it and the Surrey Langley SkyTrain line planned to end here. Condos, townhomes and detached homes sit close to shops, parks and trails.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 8, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Langley.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

I’ll show you how Langley City compares with Willoughby Heights, Murrayville and Brookswood for your budget.
Is Langley City the same as the Township of Langley?
No. The City of Langley was incorporated on March 15, 1955 as its own separate municipality, next to the Township of Langley.
Is SkyTrain coming to Langley City?
Yes. The Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension runs 16 km from King George Station to 203 Street in the City of Langley, with a current anticipated in-service date of late 2029.
Which schools are in Langley City?
The City lists Alice Brown, Blacklock, Douglas Park, Nicomekl, Simonds and Uplands elementary schools and H.D. Stafford Middle. Check the SD35 School Locator for the exact address.

What kind of homes are in Langley City?
Condos, townhomes and detached homes. Most buyers here compare strata fees and building condition as much as price.
What is at Timms Community Centre?
, at 20399 Douglas Crescent, has a gymnasium, a 120 m walking and running track, a weight room, a games room, fitness rooms and a licensed preschool. It connects to City Hall and the library.
